_note: r.164(3)(l): "is a person in whose case tax has been deducted under section 393(3) [Table : Sl No. 5]". s.393(3) Table Sl. 5: any sum paid in cash from one or more accounts, by a banking company, a co-operative society carrying on banking or a post office, 2%, above three crore rupees for a co-operative society recipient or one crore rupees for any other. The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2026-27 only: r.164(1) governs "the tax year commencing on the 1st April, 2026" (D-520 C3a).
question: Did a bank, co-operative bank or post office deduct tax on cash you withdrew from your accounts during the tax year?
